topic: 32 with 12 mutual funds? You may own the same stocks 5 times
caption:
12 funds, but are you holding the same stocks 5 times?

A large-cap fund must invest at least 80% in India's top 100 companies. Own three of them and much of your money likely sits in the same stocks. More funds on paper, not more diversification.

The 5-minute check: open each fund's latest monthly portfolio, note the top 10 holdings with % weights, circle stocks that show up in two or more funds, then add up the smaller weight of each common stock. That's the overlap for that pair.

The regulator now caps overlap at 50% for sectoral/thematic funds against the same fund house's other equity schemes (average of daily overlap over a quarter).

High overlap? Before any switch, check exit load and capital gains tax.

Save this and run the check this weekend.

Sources: SEBI circular on categorisation of mutual fund schemes (6 Oct 2017); SEBI circular on categorisation and rationalisation of schemes (26 Feb 2026).
